Applying to test: separator rows 2, 15; separator cols 4, 10, 16, 22; interior color 3; markers 6 at (2,4),(2,10),(15,4),(15,10). Only band is rows 2–15. Block cols 4–10: all four corners 6 → 6. Blocks 10–16 and 16–22: incomplete markers → 3. Output: [[6,3,3]].

```python
from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cnt = Counter(c for row in grid for c in row)
    bg = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hlines = [r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c] != bg for c in range(W))]
    vlines = [c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(H))]
    if len(hlines) < 2 or len(vlines) < 2:
        return [[bg]]
    lc = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in hlines for c in range(W)).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(hlines) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(vlines) - 1):
            corners = [grid[hlines[i]][vlines[j]], grid[hlines[i]][vlines[j+1]],
                       grid[hlines[i+1]][vlines[j]], grid[hlines[i+1]][vlines[j+1]]]
            m = [x for x in corners if x != lc]
            if len(m) == 4 and len(set(m)) == 1:
                row.append(m[0])
            else:
                row.append(bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
```

```python
from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cnt = Counter(c for row in grid for c in row)
    top2 = set(c for c, _ in cnt.most_common(2))
    markers = set(cnt) - top2
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(H) if any(grid[r][c] in markers for c in range(W))]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(W) if any(grid[r][c] in markers for r in range(H))]
    if len(sep_rows) < 2 or len(sep_cols) < 2:
        return [[cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]]]
    inner = grid[sep_rows[0] + 1][sep_cols[0] + 1]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(sep_rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(sep_cols) - 1):
            corners = [grid[sep_rows[i]][sep_cols[j]], grid[sep_rows[i]][sep_cols[j + 1]],
                       grid[sep_rows[i + 1]][sep_cols[j]], grid[sep_rows[i + 1]][sep_cols[j + 1]]]
            if len(set(corners)) == 1 and corners[0] in markers:
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(inner)
        out.append(row)
    return out
```
